88.title: feat(`auth`): add single sign-on for school accounts
88.body:
## User story

As a teacher, I want to sign in with my school account, so that I do not manage another password.

## Background

Blocks anything that needs a per-teacher identity.

comments.body: Note: any feature that needs to attribute an action to a specific teacher is blocked by this.
